fact: IDENTIC News reports that GITGE, the state telecom infrastructure manager, connected the island province of Annobon to the national fibre-optic network by submarine cable from Sao Tome, announced 3 April 2023.

The Vice-President ordered Huawei to draw up a project to improve telephone and internet coverage nationwide, including more interior coverage and a basic network covering 100% of the territory, and gave ministries and operators a week to assess it before approving a first phase; the press office links poor coverage to the urban-rural digital gap.
